metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: Is This Thing On?
metas.description: As their marriage unravels, Alex faces middle age and divorce, seeking new purpose in the New York comedy scene. Meanwhile, his wife Tess confronts sacrifices made for their family, forcing them to navigate co-parenting and identi...

metas.name: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable
metas.description: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

metas.name: David
metas.description: From his mother's songs to his clash with Goliath, David's journey from humble shepherd to anointed king tests the limits of faith, courage, and love--culminating in a battle for the soul of a kingdom.

metas.name: The Great Flood
metas.description: A disastrous great flood sweeps the planet. On what may be the last day on Earth, a desperate fight ensues to save a child from a flooding apartment.

metas.name: 10 Dance
metas.description: Two expert dancers, Shinya Sugiki and Shinya Suzuki, aim to master each other's styles for a prestigious competition, but old rivalries and potential romance complicate their partnership.

metas.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
metas.description: Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following the Flying Dutchman, a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate, to the deepest depths of the deep sea.

metas.name: Murder in Monaco
metas.description: Monaco, 1999: Billionaire banker Edmond Safra is found dead in his penthouse. The documentary examines the puzzling circumstances surrounding this wealthy financier's murder.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: Dust Bunny
metas.description: After losing her foster parents to a bedroom-dwelling beast, young Aurora hires her reclusive neighbor, a professional assassin, to hunt it, unknowingly thrusting him into a war against both human killers and supernatural terrors.

metas.name: Ella McCay
metas.description: An idealistic young woman juggles her family and work life in a comedy about the people you love and how to survive them.

metas.name: Tell Me Softly
metas.description: Kamila's life turns upside down when the Di Bianco brothers return after 7 years. Thiago gave her first kiss, Taylor was her protector. Now she's changed, but they still have a way of getting through to her like no one else can.

metas.name: Silent Night, Deadly Night
metas.description: After seeing his parents killed by someone dressed as Santa, a grown man later wears a Santa suit himself and seeks violent revenge.

metas.name: Not Without Hope
metas.description: A group of friends' fishing boat capsizes off the coast of Mexico and they're left alone stranded at sea and struggling for survival.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A handwritten manuscript of Dante Alighieri's poem "The Divine Comedy" makes its way from a priest to a mob boss in New York City, where it is taken by Nick Tosches after he's asked to verify its authenticity.

metas.name: It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: Merv
metas.description: When their beloved dog Merv loses his spark after their split, Anna and Russ are forced into the world's most awkward co-parenting arrangement.

metas.name: Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: Fackham Hall
metas.description: A new porter forms an odd bond with the youngest daughter of a well-known UK family. As the Davenport family, headed by Lord and Lady Davenport, deals with the epic disaster of the wedding of their eldest daughter to her caddish c...

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.

metas.name: Hunting Season
metas.description: When a reclusive survivalist and his daughter rescue a mysterious, wounded woman from a river, they become entangled in a deadly web of violence and revenge, forcing them to confront a brutal criminal to survive.

metas.name: Merrily We Roll Along
metas.description: Spanning three decades, the turbulent relationship between a composer and his two lifelong friends, a writer and a lyricist and playwright.

metas.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
metas.description: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Abby runs away to reconnect with her animatronic friends, uncovering dark secrets about the true origins of Freddy's and unleashing a horror hidden for decades.

metas.name: Jay Kelly
metas.description: Famous movie actor Jay Kelly embarks on a journey of self-discovery, confronting his past and present with his devoted manager Ron. Poignant and humor-filled, pitched at the intersection of regrets and glories.

metas.name: Oh. What. Fun.
metas.description: Claire plans a special Christmas, but is forgotten by her family. When they realize that she's missing, their holiday is at risk until she returns to give them the celebration they deserve.

metas.name: My Secret Santa
metas.description: Taylor disguises as Santa at a resort to fund her daughter's ski lessons. Working with the charming manager Matthew, she finds holiday cheer and a chance at love amidst challenges.

metas.name: Troll 2
metas.description: Nora, Andreas and Captain Kris leap back into action when a dangerous new troll awakes - and this time they'll need more help to take it down.

metas.name: Turbulence
metas.description: A married couple embarks on a hot-air balloon adventure, but unforeseen circumstances lead to life-threatening situations that test their love and resilience as they fight for survival.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: Eternity
metas.description: In an afterlife where souls have one week to decide where to spend eternity, Joan is faced with the impossible choice between the man she spent her life with and her first love, who died young and has waited decades for her to arr...

metas.name: Jingle Bell Heist
metas.description: At the height of the holiday season, two strangers team up to rob one of London's most famous department stores while accidentally falling in love.

metas.name: Kevin Hart: Acting My Age
metas.description: In his latest stand-up special, Kevin Hart hilariously tackles middle-age challenges, from ED pills to unexpected injuries, proving he's grown wiser but hasn't lost his comedic edge.

metas.name: Train Dreams
metas.description: A logger leads a life of unexpected depth and beauty in the rapidly-changing America of the early 1900s.

metas.name: Rental Family
metas.description: An American actor in Tokyo struggling to find purpose lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese "rental family" agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. He rediscovers purpose, belonging, and the beauty of human connection.

metas.name: The Age of Disclosure
metas.description: Featuring 34 U.S. Government insiders, this explosive documentary reveals an 80-year global cover-up of non-human intelligent life and a secret war among major nations to reverse engineer advanced technology of non-human origin.

metas.name: Wicked: For Good
metas.description: Elphaba, the future Wicked Witch of the West and her relationship with Glinda, the Good Witch of the North. The second of a two-part feature film adaptation of the Broadway musical.

metas.name: The Family Plan 2
metas.description: Now that Dan’s assassin days are behind him, all he wants for Christmas is quality time with his kids. But when he learns his daughter has her own plans, he books a family trip to London—putting them all in the crosshairs of an un...

metas.name: Sisu: Road to Revenge
metas.description: A man returns to dismantle his family's house, where they were murdered in war, to rebuild it elsewhere. When the killer, a Red Army commander, tracks him down, a brutal cross-country pursuit begins.

metas.name: Diabolic
metas.description: A woman's hope for a miracle cure turns into a nightmare when she confronts the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch, determined to claim her as a vessel for her evil power.

metas.name: Champagne Problems
metas.description: An executive travels to France to secure the acquisition of a renowned champagne brand before Christmas, but her plans are upended when she falls into a whirlwind romance with a charming Parisian - only to discover he's the founde...

metas.name: The Carman Family Deaths
metas.description: A fishing trip ends in tragedy when Linda Carman vanishes at sea leaving her son Nathan adrift for days. His rescue stirs up questions about his grandfather's murder and ignites a battle over inheritance that leads to shocking rev...

metas.name: O Filho de Mil Homens
metas.description: The first screen adaptation of Valter Hugo Mãe's bestselling novel. A lonely 40-year-old fisherman dreams of becoming a father and meets Camilo, an orphaned boy. Drawn together by fate, they form an unconventional family.

metas.name: The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: Trap House
metas.description: A DEA agent and his partner pursue thieves: their own rebellious teens, who began robbing the cartel using their parents' tactics and classified intel.

metas.name: The Carpenter's Son
metas.description: Family hiding in Roman Egypt. Son known as 'the Boy' doubts guardian 'the Carpenter', rebelling with mysterious powers. As he uses abilities, they face natural and divine horrors.

metas.name: Muzzle: City of Wolves
metas.description: Haunted ex-K-9 officer Jake's peaceful life is shattered when a gang brutally attacks his family. With new K-9 partner Argos, he uncovers a drug ring, confronts corrupt officials, and fights inner demons while pursuing the criminals.

metas.name: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
metas.description: The Four Horsemen reunite and team up with a new generation of young illusionists to expose a diamond heiress's global money laundering scheme for criminals.

metas.name: Keeper
metas.description: A romantic anniversary trip to a secluded cabin turns sinister when a dark presence reveals itself, forcing a couple to confront the property's haunting past.

metas.name: A Very Jonas Christmas Movie
metas.description: Three famous brothers race against time and face mounting challenges during a chaotic journey from London to New York, desperate to make it home in time for Christmas with their loved ones.

metas.name: In Your Dreams
metas.description: Stevie and her little brother Elliot journey into the wildly absurd landscape of their own dreams to ask the Sandman to grant them the perfect family.

metas.name: Nouvelle Vague
metas.description: The behind the scenes of the filming of Jean-Luc Godard's Breathless (1960), a landmark of the French New Wave film movement.

metas.name: A Merry Little Ex-Mas
metas.description: A separated couple tries celebrating one last Christmas together with their kids before their divorce. However, the husband's new girlfriend joins the festivities, causing tension and chaos during the holidays.

metas.name: Being Eddie
metas.description: Follows a comprehensive look at Eddie Murphy's life and career.

metas.name: Playdate
metas.description: Brian has just been fired from his job. He becomes a stay-at-home dad. He accepts a playdate invitation from another stay-at-home dad who turns out to be a loose cannon.

metas.name: Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: Nuremberg
metas.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing increasingly obsessed with understanding evil as he forms a disturbing bond with Hermann Göring.

metas.name: Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.name: The Choral
metas.description: A choral society's male members enlist in World War I, leaving the demanding Dr. Guthrie to recruit teenagers. Together, they experience the joy of singing while the young boys grapple with their impending conscription into the army.

metas.name: Mango
metas.description: Lærke, an ambitious hotel manager, is sent to Malaga to develop a hotel on Alex's mango farm. Lærke's daughter joins, expecting a rare holiday. Unexpected feelings arise between Lærke and Alex, forcing them to make life-altering c...

metas.name: Christy
metas.description: The life and the incredible career of Christy Martin, the most successful female boxer of the 1990s.

metas.name: The Secret Agent
metas.description: Amid the political turmoil of Brazil in 1977, a technology expert is forced into hiding and seeks help from the underground resistance as he tries to flee the country with his young son.

metas.name: Worldbreaker
metas.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead.

metas.name: Icefall
metas.description: The story revolves around a young Native American game warden who captures a notorious poacher only to learn that the poacher is aware of the location of a plane carrying millions of dollars that has crashed in a frozen lake.

metas.name: Killing Faith
metas.description: A widowed doctor escorts a freed slave and her daughter across the West to find a distant faith healer, battling the mother's belief of possession and the doctor's suspicion of disease as everything the child touches dies.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: Safe House
metas.description: Six federal agents in hiding after LA terror attack grow suspicious of each other as they realize the perpetrator could be among them.

metas.name: Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
metas.description: Aileen Wuornos killed 7 men while working as a prostitute in Florida (1989-90), claiming self-defense against rape.

metas.name: The Rats: A Witcher Tale
metas.description: Follows a group of thieves as they plan the biggest heist of their lives against the most dangerous crime ring in the kingdom.

metas.name: Ballad of a Small Player
metas.description: When his past and his debts start to catch up with him, a high-stakes gambler laying low in Macau encounters a kindred spirit who might just hold the key to his salvation.

metas.name: A House of Dynamite
metas.description: When a single, unattributed missile is launched at the United States, a race begins to determine who is responsible and how to respond.

metas.name: Regretting You
metas.description: A mother and daughter must grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover themselves.

metas.name: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere
metas.description: Bruce Springsteen's journey crafting his 1982 album Nebraska, which emerged as he recorded Born in the USA with the E Street Band. Based on Warren Zanes' book.

metas.name: Blue Moon
metas.description: Tells the story of Lorenz Hart's struggles with alcoholism and mental health as he tries to save face during the opening of "Oklahoma!".

metas.name: Hedda
metas.description: Henrik Ibsen's renowned stage drama from 1891 is reimagined in an epic and emotional way.

metas.name: The Shrinking Man
metas.description: Shipbuilder inexplicably shrinks, gets trapped in basement, few inches tall. Must fight for survival in now-hostile ordinary household environment. Sci-fi premise, no explanation given for shrinking phenomenon.

metas.name: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
metas.description: An upscale suburban mom brings a new nanny, Polly Murphy, into her home, only to discover she is not the person she claims to be.

metas.name: Dead of Winter
metas.description: A woman, travelling alone through snowbound northern Minnesota, interrupts the kidnapping of a teenage girl. Hours from the nearest town and with no phone service, she realizes that she is the young girl's only hope.

metas.name: Afterburn
metas.description: After a massive solar flare destroys the Earth's eastern hemisphere, an emboldened treasure hunter for hire adventures to Europe to uncover the coveted Mona Lisa, only to learn the world needs a hero more than it needs a painting.

metas.name: Good Fortune
metas.description: A well-meaning but rather inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy venture capitalist.

metas.name: Black Phone 2
metas.description: As Finn, now 17, struggles with life after his captivity, his sister begins receiving calls in her dreams from the black phone and seeing disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp known as Alpine Lake.

metas.name: The Twits
metas.description: Two orphans join forces with a family of magical animals to save their city from the powerful Mr. and Mrs. Twit, the meanest, smelliest, nastiest people in the world.

metas.name: Truth & Treason
metas.description: When loyalty to country becomes loyalty to a lie, one teen risks everything to expose the truth. With the Gestapo closing in, he must decide what it really means to be a good German.

metas.name: The Perfect Neighbor
metas.description: A minor disagreement between neighbors in Florida takes a lethal turn, with police body camera footage and interviews probing the aftermath of the state's controversial "stand your ground" laws.

metas.name: After the Hunt
metas.description: A college professor finds herself at a personal and professional crossroads when a star pupil levels an accusation against one of her colleagues and a dark secret from her own past threatens to come to light.

metas.name: She Walks in Darkness
metas.description: A young Spanish civil guard goes undercover within ETA, the Basque separatist group, spending over a decade locating their hideouts in the South of France.

metas.name: Urchin
metas.description: A young addict living on the streets of London is given a shot at redemption, but his road to recovery soon curdles into a strange odyssey from which he may never escape.

metas.name: The Astronaut
metas.description: When an astronaut crash-lands back to Earth, a General places her in quarantine for rehabilitation and testing. As disturbing events unfold, she fears that something extraterrestrial has followed her home.

metas.name: Good News
metas.description: In the 1970s, a covert team is determined to land a hijacked plane by any means necessary.

metas.name: Culpa Nuestra
metas.description: Nick and Noah's relationship peaks before facing events testing if they're meant to be together or should part ways. Can they overcome their past despite strong feelings, or are love and forgiveness not enough?

metas.name: Dog 51
metas.description: In a future Paris divided by class, an AI named ALMA oversees society. When its creator is assassinated, a top agent and a jaded cop are forced to work together to solve a murder that may expose the dark secrets of the system they...

metas.name: Druga Furioza
metas.description: Female cop blackmails her ex's brother with jail time unless he spies on a hooligan gang.

metas.name: It Was Just an Accident
metas.description: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor. Panicked, he rounds up a few of his fellow ex-prisoners to confirm the man's identity.

metas.name: 100 Meters
metas.description: Gifted runner Togashi dominates 100m races until transfer student Komiya arrives, motivating him to train harder. Years later, they compete as rivals on the racetrack.

metas.name: Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
metas.description: While trying to manage her own life and career, a woman on the verge of a breakdown must cope with her daughter's illness, an absent husband, a missing person, and an unusual relationship with her therapist.

metas.name: Tron: Ares
metas.description: A highly sophisticated program, Ares, is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission.

metas.name: Deathstalker
metas.description: A remake of the cult classic 1983 sword and sorcery film.

metas.name: Kiss of the Spider Woman
metas.description: Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency. An unlikely bond forms as Molina recounts a Hollywood musical plot starring Ingrid Luna.
